_comment: Opening: prologue cutscenes a_010_cs_010/030/040 and the first playable area (script/a_010.pack ie.bxon). Fan translation; dialogue is auto-wrapped at build time.

id./script/a_010.pack|ie.bxon|24c: Use the Circle Pad to move in 3D on the top screen, or the +Control Pad to move in 2D on the bottom screen.
id./script/a_010.pack|ie.bxon|f90: Here to see the King? His Majesty has already retired for the night. Come back in the morning.
id./script/a_010.pack|ie.bxon|1050: It seems you can't enter the castle until morning. Wait here until morning?
